classification_precedence: Exact owner decisions and terminal or closeout receipts.
Current Craft next-move and artifact bindings as a non-authority read model.
Names, plans, and declared status fields only as orientation evidence.

classifications.completed: The directory reached its explicit bounded development outcome; this does not imply live-product implementation, release, or authority.
classifications.active: A selected or current continuation exists and is not stopped by an unresolved prerequisite.
classifications.blocked: Useful evidence exists, but the current continuation cannot cross an explicit semantic, owner, admission, or validation gate.
classifications.superseded: A newer accepted baseline or successor makes this directory non-operative while its provenance remains useful.
classifications.historical: The directory records finished research, review, or workflow evidence and has no current execution continuation.

migration_dispositions.carry-forward-active-dependency: Preserve because current live runtime or canonical consumers depend on this directory.
migration_dispositions.carry-forward-continuation: Preserve as an open continuation package, without treating it as implemented product state.
migration_dispositions.preserve-completed-provenance: Preserve bounded completion evidence needed to explain or validate the working product.
migration_dispositions.archive-superseded-provenance: Preserve outside the active successor surface as superseded evidence.
migration_dispositions.archive-historical-provenance: Preserve outside the active successor surface as research, review, or workflow history.
